# Upgrading to 0.4.1

<!-- upgrade-from: v0.4.0 -->

Dependency patch release: no database migration, binding or API change. From 0.3.x, first apply the
[0.4.0 upgrade](0.4.0.md).

Bump the `@castra-kit/*` packages to `0.4.1` and run `pnpm install`.
